tools.name: Tranquilizing Shot
limitations: Removes one beneficial Magic effect and one Enrage effect

tools.name: Kodo Tranquilizer
limitations: Passive modifier for Tranquilizing Shot rather than a separate cast
Only removes eligible effects from nearby enemies

tools.name: Devilsaur Tranquilizer
limitations: Passive modifier for Tranquilizing Shot rather than a separate cast
Reduces the cooldown only when Tranquilizing Shot removes an Enrage effect without also removing Magic

tools.name: Feign Death
limitations: Only cancels mechanics that retarget or stop when the Hunter becomes invalid
Does not cleanse effects without Emergency Salve
Thirty-second cooldown starts after the aura ends

tools.name: Emergency Salve
limitations: Passive modifier requiring Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle

tools.name: Binding Shot
limitations: Requires enemies to move far enough from the arrow

tools.name: Intimidation
limitations: Uses the Marksmanship Spotting Eagle instead of a pet

tools.name: Aspect of the Turtle
limitations: Does not remove damage-over-time effects already applied

provenance.description: Current Marksmanship Hunter ability guide identifies the specialization's interrupt, enemy Magic and Enrage removal, control, and defensive tools.
Current Counter Shot spell record confirms its interrupt, range, lockout, and cooldown.
Current Intimidation spell record confirms the single-target stun and cooldown; the Marksmanship guide documents its Spotting Eagle implementation.
Current Harrier's Cry record confirms Marksmanship's innate Bloodlust equivalent and shared Sated lockout.
Current Marksmanship Mythic+ guide provides dungeon-specific target-drop, self-cleanse, control, and enemy-removal recommendations.
Current Binding Shot record confirms its exact spell ID and movement-triggered area-control behavior.
Current Tar Trap record confirms its exact spell ID, area slow, active limit, and cooldown.
Current Kodo Tranquilizer record identifies its exact spell ID and area modifier for Tranquilizing Shot.
Current Devilsaur Tranquilizer record confirms its Enrage-only cooldown reduction condition.
Current Posthaste record confirms self movement-impairment removal through Disengage.
Current Emergency Salve record confirms self poison and disease removal through Feign Death or Aspect of the Turtle.
